errors.text_span: Оста X е обозначена като "Внос" и "Износ"
errors.evidence: The X-axis represents the years from 2004 to 2019. "Внос" (Imports) and "Износ" (Exports) are labels for the two separate sub-plots that comprise the figure, not labels for the X-axis itself.

errors.text_span: Тя започва от около 78% през 2004 г. и постепенно намалява до около 72% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns values to the EC (ЕС) line. The dotted line for EC is consistently between approximately 58% and 67% across both plots and never reaches 78% or 72%. These values seem to be a misreading of another line.

errors.text_span: след това леко се повишава до около 75% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The description for the OECD (ОИСР) line is inaccurate. In both the Import and Export plots, the solid line for OECD ends around 73-74% in 2019, not 75%. While a minor discrepancy on its own, it contributes to the overall inaccuracy of the trend description.

errors.text_span: Третата линия е пунктирана, черна и представлява търговията с ОИСР (без членове на ЕС).
errors.evidence: The line for 'ОИСР (без членове на ЕС)' is a long-dash line, not a dotted ('пунктирана') line. The dotted line represents 'ЕС'.

errors.text_span: Тя започва от около 10% през 2004 г. и постепенно се покачва до около 25% през 2019г., с по-бърз растеж между 2015 и 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The numerical values and trend described for the 'ОИСР (без членове на ЕС)' line are incorrect. In the Import plot, this line decreases from ~25% to ~12%. In the Export plot, it decreases from ~32% to ~29%. The description provides hallucinated values and a completely opposite trend.

errors.text_span: Четвъртата линия е пунктирана, тъмно сива и представлява търговията с БРИКС.
errors.evidence: The line for BRICS (БРИКС) is a dash-dot line, not a dotted ('пунктирана') line.

errors.text_span: Тя започва от около 3% през 2004 г.
errors.evidence: This starting value is only correct for the Export plot. For the Import plot, the BRICS line starts at approximately 22%. By failing to distinguish between the two plots, the description presents an incomplete and misleading picture.

errors.text_span: Петтата линия е плътна, сива и представлява търговията със съседни държави.
errors.evidence: The line for 'съседни държави' (neighboring countries) is a short-dash line, not a solid ('плътна') line. The solid line represents 'ОИСР'.

errors.text_span: Тя започва от около 12% през 2004 г. и покачва до около 18% през 2019 г., с по-остри промени в периода от 2016 до 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The numerical values and trend for the 'съседни държави' line are incorrect. In both the Import and Export plots, this line shows a decreasing trend. It starts around 18-20% and ends around 10-13%. The description provides hallucinated values and the opposite trend.

The description fails to identify the most critical structural feature of the figure: that it consists of two separate side-by-side plots, one for 'Внос' (Imports) and one for 'Износ' (Exports). It incorrectly analyzes the data as if it were a single plot, which is a fundamental misinterpretation.
